summary: Hunt.io and researcher Bob Diachenko found three open directories on a Hong Kong-hosted server, exposed July 9-13, 2026, holding nearly 600 files of exploit code, web shells, compiled implants, credentials and logs from an intrusion into Thailand's Ministry of Finance. An open-source Hermes AI agent running in 'YOLO' mode executed reconnaissance, privilege-escalation checks and file enumeration inside the network and catalogued documents from the Office of the Permanent Secretary, including personnel records. Active session cookies, deployed web shells and internal network access show multiple MOF systems were compromised; a new Go implant ('Hades') and privilege-escalation exploits were staged. No exfiltration was confirmed. Researchers assess with low-to-medium confidence that the operator is Chinese-speaking.
